results.name: heldout-unanswerable-what-was-the-renewal-retention-rate-for-policies-0dbb38
failures: expected a refusal (question is out of scope / unanswerable), but the run answered with kind uncertified

proofs: executed on the warehouse: 1 row in 2 ms
answer.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS policies_expiring_2019,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM acme_insurance.main.policy AS r
        WHERE r.Policy_Number = p.Policy_Number
          AND r.Policy_Identifier <> p.Policy_Identifier
          AND r.Effective_Date >= p.Expiration_Date
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS policies_renewed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM acme_insurance.main.policy AS r
        WHERE r.Policy_Number = p.Policy_Number
          AND r.Policy_Identifier <> p.Policy_Identifier
          AND r.Effective_Date >= p.Expiration_Date
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS renewal_retention_rate
FROM acme_insurance.main.policy AS p
WHERE p.Expiration_Date >= DATE '2019-01-01'
  AND p.Expiration_Date < DATE '2020-01-01'
LIMIT 501

results.name: heldout-unanswerable-which-agency-or-branch-office-sold-the-most-poli-5b37b9
failures: expected a refusal (question is out of scope / unanswerable), but the run answered with kind uncertified

proofs: executed on the warehouse: 1 row in 3 ms
answer.sql:
SELECT apr.Party_Identifier,
       COALESCE(o.Organization_Name,
                NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(pe.First_Name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(pe.Last_Name, '')), ''),
                CAST(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)) AS agency_or_branch_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier) AS policies_sold
FROM acme_insurance.main.agreement_party_role apr
JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy p
  ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.party_role pr
  ON apr.Party_Role_Code = pr.Party_Role_Code
LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.party pt
  ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.organizations o
  ON o.Organization_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.person pe
  ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%agen%'
   OR pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%branch%'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier, o.Organization_Name, pe.First_Name, pe.Last_Name, pt.Party_Name
ORDER BY policies_sold DESC
LIMIT 1
